{{Quote|A skilled ''naur'alor'' can shape ''beskar'' into almost any form, manipulating its strength, color, and other properties. This knowledge is ours alone...|Tor Vizsla, ''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad''|<ref name="TBHC" />}}
'''''Naur'alor''''' was a title in the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture. It was bestowed upon a [[Metalsmith/Legends|metalsmith]] that worked with [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] iron. The title was noted in ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]'', a manifesto of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] Mandalorian splinter group. The document was supposedly [[Author/Legends|written]] by the movement's [[Secret Mandalore|leader]], [[Tor Vizsla]]&mdash;although the Death Watch's opponent [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] doubted its authenticity&mdash;and was eventually included in the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'' by Jango's son, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="TBHC" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The title of ''naur'alor'' was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe as part of the [[2013]] bounty hunter reference guide ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', co-[[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Jason Fry]], and [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="TBHC" />
